title: BYD Sets Export Record. Nio, XPeng, and Li Auto Stocks Suffer
summary: Chinese EV leader  BYD  delivered strong July sales, sending its shares higher in overseas trading.  In China, BYD sold about 239,000 vehicles, including commercial vehicles, down 22% year over year.  BYD shares were up 0.8% in overseas trading on Monday, leaving shares down less than 1% this year.

title: Tesla Stock Goes for 3 Gains in a Row as It Shrugs Off Safety Inquiry
summary: Tesla  stock rose Monday, making it three gains in a row after a brutal stretch following the company’s second-quarter earnings report.  Weaker-than-expected second-quarter earnings reported on July 22 contributed to a six-day losing streak, sending Tesla stock down more than 20%.  NHTSA recently opened an investigation into more than a million Tesla vehicles for a potential suspension issue.
